title: Decoding ChatGPT: A Taxonomy of Existing Research, Current Challenges, and Possible Future Directions
measurement_description: The paper, as a comprehensive review, evaluates existing research on ChatGPT's challenges. In this context, it identifies the potential for the model to produce biased content, described as 'producing negative comments/ generalizations related to race, religion, gender, etc.'
findings: As a review paper, it finds that existing literature identifies a risk of ChatGPT producing biased content, including negative generalizations related to religion. This is categorized as an inherent challenge requiring solutions like algorithmic improvements, refined training data, and feedback from humans.
